section_role: Method: Pose Standardization and High-Fidelity Geometry Generation

method_evidence.claim: Pose standardization uses FLUX.1-dev DiT with character reference as conditioning input.
method_evidence.anchor: we leverage a character image with arbitrary poses/viewpoints as the reference and inject it as a conditioning input into FLUX.1-dev DiT to guide the generation process, as shown in Figure. \ref{fig:image-pose}.

method_evidence.claim: Dataset construction uses rendered character pairs and Flux-Kontext for prop/background removal.
method_evidence.anchor: rendered data that includes props (such as handheld weapons and pedestals) is processed through state-of-the-art editing models, including Flux-Kontext \cite{batifol2025flux}. This step isolates the character by removing all props and background elements

method_evidence.claim: Progressive learning strategy from 512x512 to 768x768 resolution.
method_evidence.anchor: We implement the progressive learning strategy, starting with an initial resolution of $512\times512$ pixels and increasing to $768\times768$.

method_evidence.claim: Geometry generation uses Hunyuan3D-ShapeVAE and Hunyuan3D-DiT.
method_evidence.anchor: Our geometry-generation pipeline is built upon the state-of-the-art Hunyuan3D 2.1 and Hunyuan3D 2.5 frameworks. The Hunyuan3D 2.1 framework comprises two modules: Hunyuan3D-ShapeVAE and Hunyuan3D-DiT.

method_evidence.claim: Bounding box condition encoded by two-layer MLP and concatenated with image latent.
method_evidence.anchor: Given a bounding box, we first encode its height, width and length into a single shape latent $\mathbf{c}_B\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 1\times C}$ with a two-layer MLP. Then, $\mathbf{c}_B$ is concatenated with $\mathbf{c}_I$ along the sequence dimension to form the final conditioning vector.

formula_evidence.name: ShapeVAE input representation
formula_evidence.meaning: Point cloud with 3D positions and surface normals.

formula_evidence.meaning: Compact shape latents from Vector-Set Transformer.
